notes.title: Update announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We fixed some bugs about wrong achievements and unable to get all CG.
Your achievements will upload without do anything, but if you have not collected every event-CG, please restrat from last Day at frist.
We are sorry for your troubles.

About ENGLISH & Japanese version:
We're waitting for developer to offer translation of scenario.
We'll make English version after we got translation.

Thank you for your interest in this game.

notes.title: Deferred information
notes.content:
"She is Mermaid" Simplified Chinese version has passed Steam review and is set for release, however, we are now waiting for the Steam staff to add a country restriction for Korea (as per our agreement with the developers).

Due to our misunderstanding with how country restrictions work and the wishes of the original developers, we will have to hold off the release for now. Once the country restriction has been applied, we will release the game.

We try to think of this as a learning process for ourselves. If we are able to represent more games in the future, we will attempt to resolve issues like these earlier in the pre-release phases and communicate better with the developers to make sure problems like these don't arise again.

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: 'She is Mermaid DEMO version' has been released now!
notes.content:
'She is Mermaid DEMO version' has been released now!
This demo version include the first Chapter.
Currently only available in Simplified Chinese.
We will add traditional Chinese, English and Japanese。

Thanks for your attention.

notes.title: Deferred information
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.
Sorry for the delay, but we're still bug testing the voice and performance of the second half of the game.
 
So the release date of this game will be postponed to 8/30.
 
If we are able to release the game before this date, we will inform you as soon as possible.
 
Other than this, we expect to release the demo version within the week!
 
We also want to introduce the changes made in the PC version.
The original version has more than 100 photo-modified backgrounds and we have replaced 50 of these backgrounds. Additional backgrounds have been purchased with the style of the game in mind to better suit the characters and setting of the game. Extra features have also been included that were not in the original.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32955901/9a4f2a44555fff6450dc6739a0d852259d8c3987.jpg[/img]


We hope that the characters will have more emphasis when they are shown over these new backgrounds.
 
In addition, this work was funded on Kickstarter by Sekai Project to make a Switch version.
A total of 634 people participated, successfully raising an amazing 18,757 dollars!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32955901/e2a3810f71493c9359e8fae4a33b8239a3e285c9.jpg[/img]

We are very glad to see so many oversees players interested in this project!
 
Please wait for us to complete our testing so we can give you the best experience possible. Thank you.
